cityScopes.arlington_va: 125 unchanged native parcel polygons passed all eight qualification gates in bounded cells around the UN/WUP locator. Fresh independent metric audit (EPSG:32618) found zero invalid polygons, identity conflicts, duplicate geometry, material overlaps, or operation errors. Citywide completeness, legal title, survey accuracy, and currentness are not established. The Washington urban-area locator is in Arlington County, Virginia; this entry does not claim Virginia parcel coverage in the District of Columbia. The existing Washington, D.C. municipal integration is unchanged.
